stem: Based on the information in the selection, how can customers benefit from being tracked by technology?

options.label: F
options.text: They can purchase different varieties of the products they usually buy.

options.label: G
options.text: They can be made aware of offers and promotions specific to their needs.

options.label: H
options.text: They can find out which products at the supermarket are the most popular.

options.label: J
options.text: They can look up which products they have purchased before.
